Throughout the discussion, the arguments presented by my fellow shareholders, particularly those supporting Option C, reinforced my perspective. The emphasis on operational discipline, shared accountability, and the value of consistent engagement resonated strongly with my analytical and conscientious approach. Yuriko’s cautionary stance advocating Option A challenged me to more deeply consider the merits of capital preservation and flexibility in the absence of historical data. This insight refined my view by highlighting the cultural and operational benefits beyond pure financial metrics. Moving forward, it will be valuable to remember that my thinking evolved not by changing my preferred option, but by deepening my appreciation for the interplay between financial strategy and organizational culture.
